remarks: Welcome to the immaculate two-family in convenient Hyde Park area. Features natural woodwork throughout, remodeled kitchens, dining rooms and 2 bedrooms each apt. Excellent condition inside and out. Many updates include glass block windows, two new furnaces and hot water tanks. Beautifully landscaped with many flowers and shrubs....located just minutes from shopping and bus lines. This paradise features majestic two-family residence stands proudly like a king on the street. Set on one of the most beautiful tree-lined streets, it creates a peaceful, quiet atmosphere that almost makes you forget you are in the heart of Niagara Falls. This is not your typical multi-family property. Both units offer an incredible single-family-home feel thanks to their exceptionally spacious layouts and generously sized living areas. The lower unit features 2 well-appointed bedrooms, as does the upper. Every bedroom is impressively sized with comfort and practicality in mind. The home has been lovingly maintained and cared for throughout the years, showing pride of ownership at every turn. A full attic and basement provide an incredible amount of additional storage space, adding even more functionality to the property. Outside, a private backyard surrounded by mature trees creates a peaceful retreat with a touch of natural privacy. Also four car parking around the back of the house. Whether you are looking for an owner-occupied opportunity or a strong investment property with rare unit sizes, this is a property that is difficult to replicate in today’s market.
